Questionable quality
Mar 2024 • Couples
Outdoor restaurant run by Russians. Intrigued by the long queue at the entrance with dozens of people waiting, we asked to be added to the list and waited our turn for about half an hour.
Once inside you are accompanied to a table where a grill and embers are brought to independently cook what you choose from the buffet.
The price is fixed; drinks are paid (except water and tea from dispensers, which I would avoid).
The choice is quite varied, but I didn't find high quality ingredients, especially the fish looked unappealing. A snake was also spit-roasted, but it was finished in an instant.
The fruit buffet is decent.

Interesting food to try but overpriced
Jul 2019 • Couples
We went purely for the different types of meat to try so we don't regret our visit, however it is pick up raw meat and cook it yourself at the table. It's a nice idea but not when we're paying more than usual for the lack of service. We had to ask for my husband's drink 3 times before it finally arrived.
The food itself was nice but we did need to cook it ourselves, and we got to try some new things (crocodile, snake and frog).
They also didn't serve ice tea which seemed unusual! There are similar restaurants in the area which are cheaper and include a drink, but we haven't tried them to be able to compare
